thread:
olivia: FYI — staging embeddings service spiked 503s after the quant PR landed. Autoscaling masks it but prod margin looks low. Need expedited hotfix deploy v2.3.1-hotfix and a pin/rollback plan. Can we get approvals in the medium change window? @sam @marta
sam: on it. what's the rollback criteria? if kv cache latency > 200ms for 5m?
marta: yep that's reasonable. also want e2e smoke before cutover. I can run quick smoke in staging now.
olivia: thanks. deploy artifact is: `redwood/embeds:v2.3.1-hotfix` — patch reverts quant-op fallback. smoke command:
```
./scripts/smoke_embed.sh --env=staging --sample=100
```
jay: I'm +1 for expedited deploy if smoke passes and canary traffic level <= 1%. no SLA breach. :thumbsup:
sam: marta, can you run smoke and post results within 10m? if green i'll mark approvals.
marta: running now. cpu/latency graphs -> https://internal.grafana/redwood/d/embeds
deploy-bot: Canary deployment started: canary_id=canary-7149991234, region=us-east1, target=1%
deploy-bot: Canary health checks: 5m window. status=running
marta: smoke done — all 100 samples ok, p95 latency back to baseline.
sam: +1 from me. tagging release notes PR for small revert: https://git.redwood/release-notes/pull/555
olivia: locking change window -> medium (18:00-20:00 UTC). pin to v2.3.1-hotfix if deploy passes canary for 10m.
jay: documenting rollback trigger: sustained 5m p95 > 300ms OR >1% 5xx rate => immediate rollback to v2.3.0 and traffic cut. I'll prepare rollback playbook.
sam: deploy-bot, promote when canary healthy for 10m
deploy-bot: Canary health stable for 10m. Promoting to production now.
deploy-bot: Production deploy complete: release=redwood/embeds:v2.3.1-hotfix, rollout=100%
olivia: release notes updated and published. thanks all. closing thread.
